mapper.select: SELECT g.goods_name AS goodsName, sk.spec_info AS spec, sk.unit_name AS unitName, SUM(soi.quantity) AS salesQuantity, SUM(soi.amount) AS salesAmount FROM wms_sales_out_item soi INNER JOIN wms_sales_out so ON so.id = soi.out_id LEFT JOIN wms_goods_sku sk ON sk.id = soi.sku_id LEFT JOIN wms_goods g ON g.id = sk.goods_id WHERE so.del_flag = '0' AND so.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND so.approve_by IS NOT NULL AND so.approve_by != '' AND DATE(so.create_time) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(so.create_time) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY soi.sku_id, g.goods_name, sk.spec_info, sk.unit_name ORDER BY salesAmount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.customer_name AS customerName, COUNT(so.id) AS orderCount, SUM(so.total_amount) AS salesAmount FROM wms_sales_out so LEFT JOIN wms_customer c ON c.id = so.customer_id WHERE so.del_flag = '0' AND so.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND so.approve_by IS NOT NULL AND so.approve_by != '' AND DATE(so.create_time) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(so.create_time) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY so.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY salesAmount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT soi.sku_id AS skuId, g.goods_name AS goodsName, sk.spec_info AS spec, sk.unit_name AS unitName, SUM(soi.quantity) / #{days} AS dailyAvgQty, s.quantity AS currentStock FROM wms_sales_out_item soi INNER JOIN wms_sales_out so ON so.id = soi.out_id LEFT JOIN wms_goods_sku sk ON sk.id = soi.sku_id LEFT JOIN wms_goods g ON g.id = sk.goods_id LEFT JOIN wms_stock s ON s.sku_id = soi.sku_id AND s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE so.del_flag = '0' AND so.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND so.approve_by IS NOT NULL AND so.approve_by != '' AND DATE(so.create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY soi.sku_id, g.goods_name, sk.spec_info, sk.unit_name, s.quantity HAVING dailyAvgQty > 0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ar.ar_amount), 0) AS receivableTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ar.ar_amount - ar.received_amount > 0 AND ar.due_date < CURDATE() THEN ar.ar_amount - ar.received_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdueAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.ar_amount - ar.received_amount > 0 AND ar.due_date < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdueCount FROM wms_accounts_receivable ar WHERE ar.del_flag = '0' AND ar.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT c.customer_name AS customerName, ar.ar_amount AS receivableAmount, ar.received_amount AS receivedAmount, (ar.ar_amount - ar.received_amount) AS remainAmount, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ar.due_date) AS overdueDays FROM wms_accounts_receivable ar LEFT JOIN wms_customer c ON c.id = ar.customer_id WHERE ar.del_flag = '0' AND ar.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ar.ar_amount - ar.received_amount > 0 AND ar.due_date < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{overdueDays} DAY) ORDER BY overdueDays DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_purchase_order po WHERE po.del_flag = '0' AND po.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND po.order_status = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_sales_order so WHERE so.del_flag = '0' AND so.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND so.order_status = '0'

SELECT po.order_no AS orderNo, s.supplier_name AS supplierName, po.total_amount AS totalAmount, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), po.approve_time) AS pendingDays FROM wms_purchase_order po LEFT JOIN wms_supplier s ON s.id = po.supplier_id WHERE po.del_flag = '0' AND po.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND po.order_status IN ('1', '4') AND po.approve_time IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), po.approve_time) >= #{overdueDays} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms_purchase_in pi WHERE pi.order_id = po.id AND pi.del_flag = '0' ) ORDER BY pendingDays DESC

SELECT so.order_no AS orderNo, c.customer_name AS customerName, so.total_amount AS totalAmount, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), so.approve_time) AS pendingDays FROM wms_sales_order so LEFT JOIN wms_customer c ON c.id = so.customer_id WHERE so.del_flag = '0' AND so.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND so.order_status IN ('1', '4') AND so.approve_time IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), so.approve_time) >= #{overdueDays} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms_sales_out sout WHERE sout.order_id = so.id AND sout.del_flag = '0' ) ORDER BY pendingDays DESC

SELECT g.goods_name AS goodsName, sk.spec_info AS spec, sk.unit_name AS unitName, s.quantity AS currentStock, s.quantity * COALESCE(sk.purchase_price, 0) AS stockAmount FROM wms_stock s LEFT JOIN wms_goods_sku sk ON sk.id = s.sku_id LEFT JOIN wms_goods g ON g.id = sk.goods_id WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.quantity > 0 AND s.quantity * COALESCE(sk.purchase_price, 0) >= #{minAmount} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms_sales_out_item soi INNER JOIN wms_sales_out so ON so.id = soi.out_id WHERE soi.sku_id = s.sku_id AND so.del_flag = '0' AND so.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND so.approve_by IS NOT NULL AND so.approve_by != '' AND DATE(so.create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ) ORDER BY stockAmount DESC

SELECT sub.skuId, sub.goodsName, sub.spec, sub.unitName, sub.currentStock, sub.dailyAvgQty, FLOOR(sub.currentStock / sub.dailyAvgQty) AS estimatedDays FROM ( SELECT soi.sku_id AS skuId, g.goods_name AS goodsName, sk.spec_info AS spec, sk.unit_name AS unitName, COALESCE(s.quantity, 0) AS currentStock, SUM(soi.quantity) / #{avgDays} AS dailyAvgQty FROM wms_sales_out_item soi INNER JOIN wms_sales_out so ON so.id = soi.out_id LEFT JOIN wms_goods_sku sk ON sk.id = soi.sku_id LEFT JOIN wms_goods g ON g.id = sk.goods_id LEFT JOIN wms_stock s ON s.sku_id = soi.sku_id AND s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE so.del_flag = '0' AND so.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND so.approve_by IS NOT NULL AND so.approve_by != '' AND DATE(so.create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{avgDays} DAY) GROUP BY soi.sku_id, g.goods_name, sk.spec_info, sk.unit_name, s.quantity HAVING dailyAvgQty > 0 ) sub WHERE sub.currentStock > 0 AND sub.currentStock / sub.dailyAvgQty <= #{thresholdDays} ORDER BY estimatedDays ASC
